newsitem.title: USA: Reliance Group Holdings Q3 shr rises.
newsitem.headline: Reliance Group Holdings Q3 shr rises.

text.p: (1) Net income for 1995 quarter included an after tax charge of $4.5 million, or $0.04 per share, on disposal of discontinued operations by an investee company.
Nine Months Ended Nine Months Ended
(a) Excludes second quarter 1996 after-tax charge of $87.1 million, or $0.74 per share, for increasing net loss reserves for asbestos-related and environmental pollution claims.

(1) 1995 nine months net income included an after-tax charge of $4.5 million, or $0.04 per share, on disposal of discontinued operations by an investee company and an after-tax charge of $3.4 million, or $.03 per share, for the early extinguishment of debt. (2) Per share for 1995 nine months included a $0.03 extraordinary charge for early redemption of a subsidiary's preferred stock.
The cost of the early redemption in excess of the carrying value of the preferred stock was not charged to income, but was charged directly to shareholders' equity.
Full company name is Reliance Group Holdings Inc.
